# The Chronicles of the Ashen Horizon

## Chapter 1: The Gathering at Sunspire

Commander Katherine Vance, known to her closest friends simply as Kit, stood atop the battlements of Sunspire Fortress. Her keen hazel eyes watched the horizon for the heralds of the Eastern Marches. Beside her stood Captain Marcus Miller, captain of the vanguard, checking his broadsword. 

A messenger arrived out of breath. "Commander Vance! Sergeant Marco Mills has brought word from the frontier."

Kit turned to face the messenger. "Send Sergeant Mills up immediately."

Moments later, Sergeant Marco Mills stepped onto the ramparts. Despite the similarity of their names, Marco Mills was a stocky archer from the southern marshes, whereas Marcus Miller was a towering knight of the royal guard. 

"Commander," Mills reported, "the scarred alchemist in the lower district has completed the diagnostic of the artifact."

The scarred alchemist was a mysterious figure who never revealed his true name, known only by the burn marks across his jaw and his emerald robes.

Katherine Vance drew the Obsidian Compass from her leather pouch. The ancient artifact pulsed with faint violet light. Katherine handed the Obsidian Compass to Marcus Miller while he prepared his horse. He thanked her warmly, promising to keep the relic safe during the reconnaissance mission.

Old Barnaby, leaning against the timber railing, spat into the courtyard below. "'Ye canna trust them northern folk, Kit,' old Barnaby growled. 'They be schemin' in the dark.'"

"We have no choice, Barnaby," Katherine replied. "The ancient lore is absolute: No living soul can cross the Veil of Nyx without dissolving into ash. Only those bearing the Sunstone crest can pass through unharmed. We must reach the sanctuary before the solstice."

---

## Chapter 2: The Fall of the Breach

The siege began at dusk. Blackstone ironclads assaulted the southern walls.

During the fiercest exchange at the sally port, an enemy crossbow bolt struck Commander Katherine Vance directly in the face, completely severing her left eye. Blood poured down her cheek as Captain Marcus Miller dragged Kit behind the barricades. "Commander Vance has lost her left eye!" Miller shouted to the field surgeons.

Chaos swept through the ranks. In the retreat through the catacombs, Marcus Miller was ambushed and gave the Obsidian Compass to Sergeant Marco Mills. "Take the compass to the sanctuary, Marco! Do not let them take it!"

By dawn, bitter rumours filled the survivor camp. Whispers spread among the soldiers that Lord Evelyn was dead, reportedly slain during the collapse of the eastern gate. Kit bowed her head in mourning, grieving for Evelyn.

---

## Chapter 3: Shadows in the Mist

Five months later, the winter thaw had begun across the Frostpeak Valley.

Commander Katherine Vance sat by the hearth of the highland refuge, adjusting the black leather patch covering her left eye socket. She had learned to fight with monocular depth perception over the grueling winter months.

Ten years earlier, before the fall of Valenport, young Kit had trained under Master Corvus in the high gardens. She remembered his words: *Patience cuts deeper than steel.* The flashback faded as boots crunched on the snow outside.

A cloaked traveler entered the refuge and lowered his hood. To Kit's astonishment, it was Lord Evelyn himself. 

"Evelyn! We heard you were dead!" Kit gasped.

"The reports of my death were merely rumours spread by my own scouts," Lord Evelyn explained with a wry smile. "I deliberately planted the false report of my demise to deceive the inquisitors while I escaped through the sewer canals."

Meanwhile, Sergeant Marco Mills arrived at the refuge, holding the Obsidian Compass intact. "Commander Vance, I have guarded the compass since Captain Miller entrusted it to me at the breach."

---

## Chapter 4: The Veil of Nyx

The expedition reached the black obsidian gates of the Veil of Nyx. The swirling violet void crackled with lethal energy that would instantly disintegrate any unprotected mortal.

Before approaching the gate, the scarred alchemist presented Kit with a breakthrough: a mechanical ocular sphere forged of silver and enchanted starlight. With deliberate care, the alchemist fitted the silver ocular sphere into Katherine's empty left eye socket, magically bonding the nerves and restoring her bilateral sight. For the first time since the siege of Sunspire, Commander Katherine Vance saw the world clearly through both eyes.

Bearing the golden Sunstone crest upon her breastplate, Commander Vance stepped forward and walked directly through the shimmering Veil of Nyx. The lethal vapor parted around her without harm, true to the sacred law of the crest.
